name: Hulen Mall
summary: Relaxed mall with department stores, fashion chains & a food court, plus open-air restaurants.
demographics: Hulen Mall serves the affluent southwest Fort Worth metropolitan area, attracting primarily middle to upper-middle-income families and young professionals with household incomes ranging from $60,000 to $120,000+. The trade area encompasses well-established residential neighborhoods in southwest Fort Worth and surrounding suburbs, drawing visitors aged 25-54 who represent the core shopping demographic, along with significant traffic from families with children and teens. Shoppers at Hulen Mall typically seek convenient access to mainstream and specialty retailers, prefer a mix of shopping and dining experiences, and value the enclosed mall format for year-round climate-controlled comfort in the Texas heat.
description: Hulen Mall, located at 4800 South Hulen Street in Fort Worth, Texas, is a premier shopping destination managed by Brookfield Properties that offers visitors a diverse retail experience with unique-to-market shops and the latest trends in apparel, housewares, and more. The enclosed mall features an impressive selection of stores and restaurants, providing shoppers with everything they need for a full day of retail therapy. Beyond shopping, Hulen Mall enhances the visitor experience with outdoor eateries perfect for taking a break from power shopping, as well as entertainment options including an on-site Movie Tavern theater. The center is committed to creating memorable experiences for the community, offering seasonal attractions such as Photos with Santa during the holidays and extended holiday shopping hours to accommodate the busiest times of year. With convenient amenities, diverse dining options, and a prime Fort Worth location, Hulen Mall has established itself as a go-to destination for locals and visitors seeking quality shopping and entertainment under one roof.
